title: Fees at county electric vehicle chargers
summary: A motion to drop fees at county electric vehicle charging stations failed four to five on May 15. Bill 64, on EV charging fees, had earlier been recommended for passage by the committee on April 24. A member had proposed a $1-per-minute idle fee at County EV chargers, starting five minutes after charging ends.
